skill.name: geo-fundamentals
skill.description: Analyze public web pages for AI citation readiness using GEO checks for structure, attribution, dates, schema, and citable content.
skill.summary: Audit public web pages for Generative Engine Optimization and AI citation readiness.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The static finding is a false positive caused by a documented command example in SKILL.md. The Python helper reads local project files for GEO signals and does not show malicious intent, prompt injection, or unsafe command execution.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 157 is a Markdown table entry showing how to run the included Python script. It is documentation text, not executable shell or Ruby backtick execution.

content.value_statement: AI search citations depend on clear structure, attribution, dates, and extractable answers. This skill reviews public web pages and highlights GEO improvements for Claude, Codex, and other AI tools.
actual_capabilities: Explains core Generative Engine Optimization concepts for AI search visibility.
Compares SEO and GEO priorities for rankings, citations, and authority signals.
Lists content elements that improve citation chances in AI-generated answers.
Provides a Python checker for HTML, JSX, and TSX page audits.
Checks pages for JSON-LD, headings, author attribution, dates, FAQs, lists, and tables.
Reports average GEO score and key issues for up to 30 public pages.
limitations: The checker does not query live AI engines or measure real citation frequency.
It skips Markdown, documentation, test files, and most configuration files.
It uses pattern matching, so manual review is still needed for content quality.
It does not validate schema correctness beyond detecting common structured data markers.

use_cases.title: Improve Article Visibility
use_cases.description: Review blog posts for headings, dates, author details, and FAQ sections before publication.

use_cases.title: Audit React Pages
use_cases.description: Scan Next.js or React page components for AI-friendly structure and missing citation signals.

use_cases.title: Compare Brand Authority Signals
use_cases.description: Use the checklist to plan entity data, expert attribution, and original statistics across key pages.

prompt_templates.title: Explain GEO Basics
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain Generative Engine Optimization using this skill. Focus on what makes a page easier for AI systems to cite.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the GEO checklist to review this public page content. Identify missing structure, attribution, dates, and direct answers.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Content Updates
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a prioritized GEO improvement plan for these article pages. Include schema, author information, FAQs, and original data.

prompt_templates.title: Interpret Checker Results
prompt_templates.prompt: Interpret the geo_checker.py results for this project. Explain the highest impact fixes and the limits of the automated score.

output_examples.input: Review a product comparison article for AI citation readiness.
output: The page has clear comparison tables and several extractable facts.
Add an author byline, publication date, and FAQ schema to improve citation signals.
Include source names for statistics so AI systems can attribute claims.

output_examples.input: Explain why a page received a low GEO score.
output: The page is missing JSON-LD structured data and has no H1 heading.
It also lacks author attribution and publication dates.
Start with schema, heading cleanup, and a short FAQ section.

output_examples.input: Create a GEO checklist for a new article.
output: Add a clear definition near the top of the article.
Use one H1, several H2 sections, and a dated author byline.
Include original statistics, sources, and concise answers to common questions.

best_practices: Run the checker against public page directories, not internal docs or test folders.
Pair automated findings with manual review for accuracy, authority, and source quality.
Add schema, author details, dates, and direct answers before measuring AI citations.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the GEO score as proof that AI engines will cite a page.
Do not add unsupported statistics or vague source claims just to improve citation signals.
Do not block important AI crawlers if AI search visibility is the goal.

faq.question: What is Generative Engine Optimization?
faq.answer: Generative Engine Optimization improves content so AI systems can understand, extract, and cite it in generated answers.

faq.question: Which files does the checker analyze?
faq.answer: It looks for public HTML, HTM, JSX, and TSX page files, especially in pages, app, or routes directories.

faq.question: Does this skill contact ChatGPT, Claude, or Perplexity?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and local checks. It does not send requests to external AI services.

faq.question: Can it guarantee AI citations?
faq.answer: No. It improves readiness signals, but AI citation behavior depends on engine retrieval, content quality, and authority.

faq.question: Why does structured data matter?
faq.answer: Structured data gives AI systems clear facts about articles, authors, entities, dates, and FAQs.

faq.question: Should I review results manually?
faq.answer: Yes. The script uses pattern checks, so a human should confirm source quality, claim accuracy, and brand context.
